management_steps.details: Apply at night to affected areas for at least 6 weeks. Introduce gradually as night-time application (e.g. start twice a week and titrate up). Apply about a pea-sized amount to entire face.
Review patient after 6 weeks. Minimise exposure to sunlight; discontinue if sunburn occurs. Acne may worsen during first few weeks. Avoid eyes and area around mouth and nose.

warnings: Do not use if pregnant or planning pregnancy.
